literature_notes: L1 (PMC12390941) reports a CRISPR HiBiT knock-in into DDR1 but names no residue, no loop, and no terminus. The construct label 'DDR1-HiBiT' follows the gene-tag convention implying C-terminal placement (intracellular), and HiBiT is used in both surface and intracellular contexts; the ledger clip does not resolve which face carries the tag. The topology_derived rule requires knowing the tag is at a terminus — without that, the clip cannot pin a surface site. L2/L3 (PMC10576099) report a DDR1-EGFP C-terminal fusion that traffics to the cell surface in NIH3T3 cells; the EGFP is on the intracellular C-terminus (residue 913, within the intracellular span 439–913) and is therefore not a surface tag site. No ledger line grounds an extracellular tag insertion at a pinnable position, so zero surface sites are reported.

literature_other_positions.note: DDR1-EGFP C-terminal fusion expressed via adenovirus in NIH3T3 cells; full-length DDR1 traffics to the surface but the EGFP tag is appended to the intracellular C-terminus (residue 913, within the intracellular span 439–913).
